title: Miami's Near-Miss, Frontier's Executive Exodus, and KLM's Big Fuel Bet
summary: A Lufthansa 747 nearly gets clipped by an American 787 in Miami — the third close call we've covered in two weeks. Plus, Frontier brings in a Wizz Air exec as two of its own leaders quietly walk out, KLM takes delivery of its first A350 in a long-haul fleet overhaul, Ryanair explains why it'll never touch an Airbus, and American tries to stiff a bumped passenger out of 650 bucks.
